stem:
A student investigates the collision of two gliders A and B on a linear air-track. A card is attached to glider B, as shown in Fig. 2.1.

[[fig:f1]]

Glider B has a mass *M*. A mass *m* is added to glider B.

Glider A travels at a constant velocity *u* towards the stationary glider B. The gliders then collide and move together towards the light gate.

The card passes through the light gate which is connected to a data logger. The student records the velocity *v* of the two gliders from the data logger.

The student changes the mass *m* and repeats the experiment.

It is suggested that *v* and *m* are related by the equation

*A u* = (*M* + *m* + *A*)*v*

where *A* is the mass of glider A.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: A graph is plotted 1/*v* on the *y*-axis against (*M* + *m*) on the *x*-axis. Determine expressions for the gradient and *y*-intercept.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Values of *m* and *v* are given in Table 2.1.

The value of *M* is 330 g ± 5%.
Each value of *m* has a percentage uncertainty of ± 5%.

[[fig:f2]]

Calculate and record values of (*M* + *m*)/g and 1/*v* / s cm⁻¹ in Table 2.1. Include the absolute uncertainties in (*M* + *m*).

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text:
Plot a graph of 1/*v* / s cm⁻¹ against (*M* + *m*)/g.

Include error bars for (*M* + *m*).

[[fig:f3]]

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Draw the straight line of best fit and a worst acceptable straight line on your graph. Both lines should be clearly labelled.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text: Determine the gradient of the line of best fit. Include the absolute uncertainty in your answer.

parts.label: (c)(iv)
parts.text: Determine the *y*-intercept of the line of best fit. Include the absolute uncertainty in your answer.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.text: Using your answers to (a), (c)(iii) and (c)(iv), determine the values of *u* and *A*. Include appropriate units.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text: The experiment is repeated. Determine the value of *m* that would give a velocity *v* of 2.0 cm s⁻¹.

figures.caption: Fig. 2.1
figures.alt: A labelled diagram shows gliders A and B on an air-track, with a card attached to glider B passing through a light gate.

figures.caption: Table 2.1
figures.alt: A table has columns for m, (M + m), v and 1/v, with six rows of given m and v values and blank cells for the calculated values.
A blank graph grid is labelled with 1/v / s cm⁻¹ on the vertical axis and (M + m)/g on the horizontal axis.
